steps.content: The waves of her voice envelop you like depressing thoughts, obscuring your surroundings.
Eleven's voice cuts through everything, echoing alternately in each of your ears.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I've lost many voices... and forgotten many voices...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I miss the gentle voice of that radio host. I've tried to recall it many times, but each time I've failed...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: From then on, the world has become cruel, filled with only order, demand, petulance, compromise, stereotype, and cliché...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I want to find them back. Only you can help me retrieve them.
The face before you gradually becomes recognizable. Smiling as usual, Eleven slowly reaches out to you.
Her slightly cool palms cup the sides of your face, gentle and affectionate as if holding something precious.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I like your voice... I long to hear your voice...
Her hands slowly slide down, fingertips touching your throat. You can't help but swallow, and the cartilage in your throat glides, choking you briefly.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Speak... I only want to hear the words from your heart... the best voice different from all others...

Palms shaking, Eleven looks at you with a thrill of expectation, her thumb encouragingly pressing against the part of you that vibrates when you speak, as if wanting to remember the frequency as well.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I really didn't think it would turn out like this.
Eleven's expression freezes. She never expected that from you.

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: I'm sick of training that rookie! Can't even follow a template, can't think for a second! Just quit for god's sake!

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: Huh? What does your voice have to do with winning the project? All you have to do is butter them up a bit! It's not a darn singing competition!

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: Every day I put on this clown-like makeup and get side-eyed on the street... I'm becoming a meme at this point... Why do I do this to myself...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Why... These voices... No, not these voices...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry, I'm not as great as you think.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When I first came, I only wanted to be done with this damn work ASAP...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't come here just to save you...
You touch Eleven's wrists and gently push them away.
As you move, the voices around you break one by one, releasing countless low moans and shouts.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To be honest, I understand how you feel. When we're exhausted, we simply don't have the energy to discern whether a voice is good or bad. I blame overtime work, it's the worst invention ever.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's especially true for you, since most of the people you deal with have been influenced by such voices.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Under these circumstances, cruel words sure cut like knives, but even kind words can add fuel to the fire.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: No, enough of these unkind words. I've heard enough!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Shhh... Calm down... We still have a chance! We can still find new voices. We'll keep looking. Hide yourself for now, until I find the next person...
You want to step forward to grab Eleven, but you're blocked by another figure that's gradually becoming clear.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I won't let you touch her. Listeners can't harass the host! Your voice is no longer useful. Your work here is done. Can you just go home?

options: I'll have to come back if the case isn't solved.
I'm overworked too, I can understand you.

steps.content: You take Eleven's hand and try to make your voice sound gentle enough.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There are words other than slander and flattery in this world. I just want to speak what's close to my heart. Listen to me, Eleven.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've said that we can only break this world by finding the truly important voices. Well, surely they are not like the pretentious preaching that just came out of me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you really want? We'll figure it out and find it together!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've told you my honest thoughts. Now, can you tell me yours?
But you don't wait any longer. After all, you're a cunning adult who's been hardened by work.
Your palm releases the red thorns which quickly wrap around the three of you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What... what is this!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: No... I really don't remember... I don't remember!
Eleven's sad cry stirs up a massive wave of sounds. Your consciousness is shaken into a trance, submerged in a sea of white.
